source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Apply the clonidine patch directly over broken or irritated skin to increase absorption","B":"Replace the clonidine patch every day because the transdermal dose lasts only 24 hours","C":"Apply to clean, dry, intact hairless skin and replace on the labeled weekly schedule","D":"Cut the clonidine patch into smaller pieces whenever a lower dose is desired"}}
source_row.rationale: Transdermal clonidine patches should be applied to a clean, dry, hairless area of intact skin, changed per the product's specific labeled interval (often weekly), with site rotation to reduce skin irritation. Patches should not be cut, and application to broken or irritated skin should be avoided, since this can alter drug absorption.
